title: Find My Love
description:
A CASUAL LOVELY MEMORY GAME

Find My Love is a beautiful memory game where you must find lovely couples. Different from conventional memory games which you must find two same cards, in this game no card is equal to anyother. Find the King and Queen, the Prince and Princess, the Cowboy and Cowgirl, the Groom and Bride... and many other couples that truly loves each other. But be careful, there is some bad cards on table! Dont let any evil ideology destroy the pretty love of these couples, find each couple and help then to stay together until death do them part.

If you want play without any worries about flipping the bad cards, you can play in Relax Mode, in this mode there is no bad card on table, you will never lose. Just relax, enjoy the beautiful music and find the couples.

This is the first game of Araujo Castle. We created beautiful art and a loving atmosphere for you enjoy, relax and have fun while playing Find My Love.

FEATURES:• Beautiful images in anime style.

• 24 beautiful backgrounds.

• Beautiful, happy, relaxing and lovely background musics.

• 53 cards in total. 24 male cards, 24 female cards and 5 bad cards.

• Relax Mode: No bad card on table, just relax and find the couples.

• 24 levels in normal mode. Each level more harder than the previous level, with more cards on table. Can you win all?

• 24 levels in Relax Mode. Each level with one couple more to be found.

Find lovely couples:You will enjoy searching for them.

Don´t find the bad cards:Take care!

Romantic Atmosphere:You will fall in love for sure!

A lot of cards to find:Find All!

Beautiful Backgrounds:If has love, any place can be romantic.

Enjoy!
description_short: Find My Love is a romantic casual memory game wich you must find lovely couples and avoid finding bad cards. An ideal game for those who want to relax. Each level clear will give you a Bible versicule to help you have a happy marriage. You will love this game for sure!
